recoil.definition:
n. the backward jerk of a gun when it is fired
n. a movement back from an impact
recoil.translation:
n. 畏缩, 后退, 弹回, 反作用, 后坐力
vi. 退却, 畏缩, 弹回, 撤退, 反冲, 报应

recoil atoms.translation: [化] 反冲原子; 热原子

recoil effect.translation: [化] 反冲效应; 齐拉特-查尔默斯效应

recoil-wave.translation: [医] 回位波, 反冲波(主动脉关闭时)

recoiled.translation: v. 畏缩( recoil的过去式和过去分词 ); 退缩; 报应; 返回

recoiler.definition: n. One who, or that which, recoils.
recoiler.translation: 卷取机, 重卷机, 卷料重绕装置

recoiling.definition:
v draw back, as with fear or pain
v come back to the originator of an action with an undesired effect
v spring back; spring away from an impact
v spring back, as from a forceful thrust
recoiling.translation: v. 再绕；反冲；后退（recoil的ing形式）

recoilingly.definition: adv. In the manner of a recoil.

recoilless.definition: a. of or being a weapon that is designed to minimize recoil

recoils.definition:
n the backward jerk of a gun when it is fired
n a movement back from an impact
v draw back, as with fear or pain
v come back to the originator of an action with an undesired effect
v spring back; spring away from an impact
v spring back, as from a forceful thrust
recoils.translation:
n. （尤指枪炮的）反冲, 后坐力( recoil的名词复数 )
v. 畏缩( recoil的第三人称单数 ); 退缩; 报应; 返回

recoin.definition: v. t. To coin anew or again.

recoinage.definition:
n. The act of coining anew.
n. That which is coined anew.
recoinage.translation: n. 重铸, 重铸货币
